title: Function Health media slot
description: A framed slot for a photo, video or illustration: fills with any element (cropped like object-fit cover) or, when empty, shows a soft cream-to-sand placeholder of the same ratio and radius.
notes: the ratio is a Tailwind aspect class, e.g. aspect-[9/16]; pass h-full instead to fill a parent
name: functionhealth-media

props.name: media
props.description: the real image, video or illustration; an empty slot shows the placeholder

props.name: ratio
props.description: Tailwind aspect or size classes, e.g. "aspect-[3/4]" or "h-full"

props.name: rounded
props.description: Tailwind radius class; defaults to the 12px card radius
